confirmation.note: Evaluation fixture. The evaluator simulated this confirmation and the answers to the open questions. Revision: a D-bore is not a full cylinder, so it cannot be a measured hole. Moved to a note.

The bore has a flat 4.5 mm across for the D-shaft.
